fact: Lusaka Times reports the Ministry of Technology and Science signed an MOU with Obrizum Group for a pilot of AI adaptive learning in secondary schools and TEVET institutions, starting April 2026.
UNDP Zambia and the Lusaka Water Supply and Sanitation Company launched a pilot using AI to locate non-revenue water, with the MOU still to be signed.
ZRA Commissioner General Dingani Banda says AI helps ZRA detect importer and exporter fraud automatically, and an AI Unit is set up at ZRA headquarters.
Minister Felix Mutati says AI raised ZRA's capacity to collect revenue by 60 percent in the past two years (a claim without source in the article).
